verdict.rationale: A customer reports that Pilot's integrations with their banks and credit cards handle transaction classification with zero founder effort (pilot-comm-1). First-party docs mention 'real time account data' in the portal and integrations with hundreds of tools, but those named are Bill.com, Stripe and Gusto rather than bank feeds. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of bank and credit-card account connections, evidence of a daily automatic import cadence, and a description of how a founder links accounts.
